## Quality Checklist

Please confirm this resource meets our standards:

- [ ] **Active**: Updated within the last 12 months (or article is still relevant)
- [ ] **Documented**: Has clear README/documentation or is well-written
- [ ] **Relevant**: Directly related to C2PA
- [ ] **Accessible**: Open source or freely accessible (not behind paywall)
- [ ] **Functional**: Actually works (you've tested it)
- [ ] **Not duplicate**: Not already in the list
- [ ] **High quality**: Provides real value to C2PA users/developers
